review.reviewer: Codex disk-reuse worker (self-review; not independent/user approval)
review.decision: Proceed with reviewed selector and consumer-boundary cases
review.notes: Reviewed wrong-device risks, actual metadata origin, explicit overrides, unavailable/duplicate records, global boot ambiguity and process/app-data side effects. Initial uncommitted prototype tests were explored before reading the new design-first workflow; they were retained outside the implementation tree and removed from its test sources before this formal review. This does not claim that the exploratory prototype had prior approval. Commit this sealed record before reimplementing reviewed test sources. L1/L2 use synthetic metadata/mocked drivers and prove no native UI; real runtime install, boot, screenshot, app build and Duo interactions are separate evidence. Do not replace cloud27.1 matrix, old screenshot provenance, noReset, notifications or Keychain behavior.

cases.description: Derive one real booted iOS device and runtime after 26.5 removal
cases.setup: One booted Duo27.2, unavailable legacy26.5; synthetic simctl inventory
cases.expected: Return the actual Duo UDID/name/27.2, never historical defaults
surfaces: iOS simulator / phone and iPad test harness

cases.description: Preserve explicit UDID, OS and hardware-name constraints
cases.setup: Available shutdown Duo and another booted iOS device
cases.action: Resolve explicit UDID plus equivalent27.2.0 version and Duo hardware type
cases.expected: Pin requested real device; preserve compatible explicit OS/name values
surfaces: iOS simulator / phone and iPad test harness

cases.description: Retain an explicitly requested older installed runtime
cases.action: Resolve26.5 by explicit real UDID/OS/device type
cases.expected: Use26.5 when genuinely available; migration is not a global support-policy change
surfaces: iOS simulator / phone and iPad test harness

cases.description: Fail a missing requested OS instead of silently upgrading
cases.expected: Throw before Appium; no substitute runtime
surfaces: iOS simulator / phone and iPad test harness

cases.description: Do not equate a Duo-like device name with Duo hardware
cases.action: Constrain hardware type to iPhone Duo
surfaces: iOS simulator / phone and iPad test harness

cases.description: Reject unknown or inconsistent explicit target identity
cases.action: Use missing/padded UDID or conflicting ordinary-phone type

cases.description: Require a UDID for multiple booted devices
